sources.use: The radial-velocity correction uses an optical-redshift convention. Its barycentric correction is multiplicative. The audit uses 1+vcorr/c for the observer frequency multiplier; it does not add an optical radial-velocity correction as though it were an arbitrary radio velocity.

Composite parameters can come from different publications and need not form an internally consistent orbital solution. A PS row is tied to an individual published solution. The retained HD1461 composite row is therefore a labelled comparison input, not an adopted physical ephemeris.

The archive preserves literature conventions for argument of periastron; values may refer to a planetary or stellar reflex orbit, differing by 180 degrees. The small retained snapshot lacks the reference/time-system/uncertainty information needed to resolve that convention.
The official support page links the operator-log search and archive retrieval instructions. This is a newly examined access route, separate from the completed BL catalogue and converter-code probes.

The retrieval document describes staff/internal archive access and staging for outside users. Its background discusses historical archive problems. It establishes a possible retrieval route, not present availability or absence of this specific 2016 session. No internal system or staff account was accessed.

sources.retrieval_outcome: Web retrieval followed a redirect to NRAO CAS login and returned a non-retryable inaccessible-page error. No operator log or same-scan observable was returned. No login was attempted.
